title: Food To-Go
description:
Need to cook out on the road? Try a Skillet. You can either place the Skillet on a Campfire or Stove and put up to a full stack of raw food on it at once, or you can hold the raw food in your offhand, and use the Skillet near a source of heat to cook one at a time.

Unlike Furnaces and Smokers, Skillets do not consume fuel to cook.
